text: Last stop. Their boss is on that grey cargo plane, wheels-up in five.
I'm gonna find us a ride. You go make some noise on the apron.
Welcoming committee, twelve o'clock! Use the fuel trucks — JET A-1 really wants to explode.
More of them by the parked airliner. Don't hit the jet. Hit the TRUCK next to the jet.
Two jets on the taxiway — packed with his guys! They are NOT taking off!
Shoot the engines! Grenades! Anything!
Oh, that's gonna be on the news.
...And THAT one didn't have brakes. Okay!
He's rolling! The cargo plane is ROLLING!
Checkered jeep, coming up the taxiway! I borrowed it! Get in the back!
HOLD ON TO SOMETHING!
Company! Black SUVs, six o'clock!
They're shooting from the ramp! Take 'em out!
BARRELS! Hang on!
He's rotating! I'm putting you under that ramp — you JUMP!
NOW! JUMP!!
Yeah! YEAH! You made it!
I'm okay, by the way! The jeep... is not.
Hey — where are we flying?
...Is that a question I should be worried about?
Get up! The plane's not gonna wait!
Stay with me! Breathe! Shoot!
Not today! Not on MY runway!
He's RAMMING us!
Not the paint job!
Back off, pal!
That was a fifty-cal! Keep MOVING, don't let the dot settle!
Fifty-cal! Don't let that red dot sit on you!
...Okay. The cars are bombs. Noted.
Sniper down! Look at him go!
That's three. Roofs are getting quieter.
Haven City. The guy who owned that ship? He owns that tower. Meridian.
Red dots on the asphalt... ROOFTOPS! Watch the rooftops!
Two on the roofs, more in the cars! Use the traffic for cover.
More of them at the intersection — and two more roofs!
Is that— ANOTHER gunship?! Do they get them in bulk?!
Grenades! Hit it with the grenades!
Strafing run! Get behind something solid!
It's going down— it's going— oh. Oh no. Not that way.
...Right into Meridian. Well. That's one way to ring the doorbell.
They're dug in behind the glass at Haven Trust. Go in loud.
Whoa whoa — the whole block's shaking! Is that MERIDIAN?!
The whole block's shaking — get OUT of there! Out to the avenue!
LOOK DOWN THE AVENUE! MERIDIAN — it's going!
It's coming DOWN THE AVENUE! The subway — back by the intersection! RUN!
Meridian's coming down! It's coming DOWN THE AVENUE! RUN!
The subway — back by the intersection! GO GO GO!
DON'T LOOK BACK! DUST! THERE'S A WALL OF DUST!
...Kid? KID! Say something!
...Oh, thank God. Okay. Airport. Last stop. I'm bringing a bigger truck.
Get up! The city's not done with you!
Breathe! Shoot back! In that order!
Don't you dare die before the tower does!
Balconies! Red dot! Keep moving!
Snipers on the balconies — don't let the dot settle on you!
Even the Peugeots explode. Of course they do.
Sniper down! Off the balcony, very French.
Paris. Nine o'clock — she does the sparkle on the hour. Pretty, right?
Our guy is in the tower. His friends are on the quay. Go say bonsoir.
Use the barges and the bar for cover. And keep an eye on those balconies.
BEHIND YOU — ON THE RIVER! A tour boat full of them!
The fuel tank — at the stern! Hit it with a grenade!
...You set fire to a bateau-mouche. On the Seine. They will write songs about you.
Up the ramp and across the bridge. She's waiting.
Laser from the FIRST PLATFORM — up on the tower!
Gunship — up the river! WIDOWMAKER again?! How many of these does this guy OWN?
Grenades! And stay under the lattice, it can't see through all that iron!
It's going THROUGH the tower! Between the legs!
Hit! It's going down— LOOK — it's going into the TOWER—
...Okay. Okay. Into the LEG. That's... that's bad. Hear that?
She's groaning — she's LEANING! Get out from under her! Down to the river, east!
LOOK! LOOK AT HER! She's going over!
...She took the bridge with her.
And the whole north bank. Somebody's getting a very big bill.
Here comes the spray — RUN! I'm bringing the boat to the pontoon!
GET IN!
Look back. Look at her. Across the bridge like she's taking a nap.
Hold on to something!
...I'll miss her. She had a good run. Mostly before you showed up.
Sniper! Watch for the red line in the fog!
Longwu taxis. Built to go bang. Apparently.
Sniper down. Good.
That's a long way down for him.
Searchlight's on you! Shoot the lamp — no light, no aim!
Ha! Lights out for HIM.
Canopy's gone — he's going for a swim!
Boat's clear! It's all yours — bring it in!
GUNSHIP! Right off the edge! Hit it — the cockpit, the engines, anything!
They had ANOTHER one! West edge — it's coming up the west side!
It's roping guys onto the roof! Get them on the ropes!
Engine's hit! It's smoking — stay on it!
It dropped under the edge — watch the sides, it's coming back up!
It's going DOWN — it's going into the hill—
That's a kill! It's coming round — it's going to hit the TOWER—
She landed on the hill — the whole hillside's going into the river!
Longwu. A city built on a cliff, in the fog, two rivers deep. Last stop.
The gold tower across the river — Jinlong. Their whole crew is up there.
Hold on. Upstream — past the bridge. LOOK.
That was a whole district. ...They're switching the city off. Down the Hundred Steps — move.
They're on the landings below you — and up on the flyover. Look up, look down.
East along the river road — the bridge is at the far end.
Rooftops on your right! They're up over the shops!
Oh no. Look — LOOK at the city.
Downstream. The river road. The whole south bank. ...They're shutting Longwu down.
The bridge still has power — and so does Jinlong. Onto the bridge. GO.
It's following you across. Don't stop.
Jinlong. Clear the forecourt — the lift's on the tower's face, dead ahead.
Forecourt's clear. Step onto the lift — there's a BASE rig up on the roof. It's the only way back down.
Look at that. Just the hill and this tower left lit. ...You did not do that. Mostly.
Top of the world. ...Hear that? That is NOT the wind.
She's breaking up — she's going over! The orange locker — grab the rig!
Rig's on! The gap in the railing — run and JUMP! Don't think!
Canopy's open! Good! ...Now look RIGHT!
She's coming DOWN — right side! She's coming down WITH you!
...Jinlong Tower. Gone. Into the river.
And that was the last light in Longwu.
Jumpers! Behind you — they followed you off the roof!
The gas mains under the hill — it's all going up!
Gunboat under you! The drums on its stern — hit them!
...Nice landing. I'm two minutes out. Don't touch anything.
...Huh. Somebody found the breakers.
Get up! Last city, last fight — you do not get to quit here!
Not in the final level. Not on my watch. Up!
End of the line, truck's done. That's the port.
Their boss loads the ship at sundown. Go! I've got your back... from here.
They're coming out of the containers!
Somebody hit the lights. Great — now they can see you.
Watch the side aisles, they're flanking!
More of them in the stacks. Use the barrels — everything here burns.
Uh... the crane's moving. Why is the crane moving?!
MOVE! MOVE!!
Shoot the guy in the cab before he does that again!
That was close. Way too close.
Crane operator's fired. HR is gonna love that.
Forklift! Forklift full of fuel drums! Of course!
...I have never seen a forklift do that.
That's her. Up the gangway — the fuel hold is mid-ship.
Red valves, mid-deck. Light it up!
She's gonna blow! Get off the ship! RUN!!
...Was that our boat?
We'll take the next one.
Get up! I'm not explaining this to your mom!
You don't get to die on a Tuesday!
RPG! Too close — keep their heads down!
We're hit — we're still flying. Keep shooting!
RPG team down. Good.
You shot the flak gun off a skyscraper. With a door gun. Noted.
Drones off the door! Shoot them before they reach us!
Enemy chopper on our left — he's making a gun run!
Chopper down! Scratch one!
Did you just chain that?! Beautiful.
That was a fuel depot. WAS.
...And that was a forty-storey building. Insurance is going to love us.
Al-Sarab. Tallest skyline on Earth, and as of this morning, it's all theirs.
That's HAMMER TWO off our door. You're on the gun. Marina first — they've got men on the roofs.
Pool deck on the left — gunmen. Light them up!
Helipad — RPG! Shoot the rocket if you have to!
Marina clear. Moving down the boulevard.
Crescent Boulevard. Every roof on the left is shooting at us.
HAMMER TWO, tighten up on our left.
RPG — HAMMER TWO, BREAK—
HAMMER TWO is hit! He's going in — he's going in!
...No chutes. Make them pay for it.
Boulevard clear. Turning south.
Hold on. Look south. ...That's not smoke.
Haboob. A sandstorm the size of the city — and it's coming right at us.
Contact! Gunship in the dust — WIDOWMAKER again. How many of these do they HAVE?
Rockets! Shoot them out of the air!
He's going down — into that tower! LOOK!
Splash! Fast movers took him. Thank you, Air Force.
Storm's breaking. Flak towers ahead — four of them. Laser's on your left hand: hold it on the building till it locks.
They're blowing their own buildings now. Scorched earth.
That's all four. Now the big one.
Bombers have the rest. Come about — the Spire.
Fuel tankers on the street below — light them up!
SARAB SPIRE. Eight hundred metres of command post. Paint her, then hang on to something.
Bombers are on her. Watch the Spire!
Here she comes...
THE SPIRE — IT'S COMING AT US! HOLD ON!
...She is down. Al-Sarab just lost its skyline.
Master caution's lit. Number two engine's eating sand. We're going home slow.
Look at it. Twenty minutes ago that was a city.
Stay on that gun! I'm not flying home alone!
Black SUVs, six o'clock. Get on the gun!
Woo! That one had a sunroof!
Nice! Reload, more coming!
One coming back from ahead — eyes front!
Is that a fuel tanker? Don't you dare...
You did. You absolutely did.
Four more! They're gonna try to box us in!
Is that... rotor noise?
It called friends!
...We should really get this truck washed.
Stay with me! You don't get to die before the credits!
It's going down — it's going down ON US!
He's gonna ram us!
Helicopter! Why is it ALWAYS a helicopter?!
Red dot! Up on the screens — the catwalk!
Sniper on the big screen catwalk! Don't let the dot settle on you!
Even the taxis explode. Of course they do.
Sniper down! Good. That one was ruining the ads.
You shot the cola ad. Somewhere a marketing guy just felt that.
It's leaking! Hit it again!
Kurogane. Three in the afternoon. Busiest crossing on Earth, and not one tourist. That's how you know.
Our guy's on the far side of the crossing. His friends are between you and him. Down the stairs.
Plaza first. Then the crossing — the cars are your cover.
...Every screen in Kurogane just went to emergency broadcast. Subtle.
Station east exit, on your left. The expressway ramp is up past the decks — they're waiting on them.
Another dot — across the avenue, on the roof!
Look up! They're on the walkways — every bridge over the plaza.
Stairs at the east end take you up onto the deck.
Up the stairs. Station terrace at the top, then the link onto the expressway.
Shuto expressway, jammed solid both ways. Duck between the cars and keep going west.
Roof across the road — red dot, north side!
That's a fuel tanker. In the middle of a jam. On a bridge. ...Yeah, you know what to do.
The TANKER! Shoot the tanker!
...She's going— the WHOLE SPAN is going—
...You dropped a piece of expressway on a street. In Tokyo. They will never let me drive here again.
Emergency stairs, right there on the south side! Down, down, down — into Center-gai.
Center-gai. Watch the shops — they love a doorway.
Smell that? The fuel off that tanker's running into the drains...
Wait— that's gas. The fuel's in the gas main. LOOK — back up the street!
RUN! RUN! OUT TO THE CROSSING!
Keep going! It's right behind you!
GET DOWN!
...Okay. Okay. You're alive. The street isn't.
Get up! Tokyo's not done with you!
Don't you dare die in a karaoke district!
Sniper! Follow the laser back to him — and keep moving!
Red dot! Somewhere high — don't let it settle on you!
Good. Anything with a fuel tank is a bomb up here. Use that.
...There goes the fondue.
Sniper down! Long way to the bottom, buddy.
...You alive? Good. That was our snowcat. The road's the only way up now.
Three hairpins to the cable car. And they know we're coming — see the headlamps?
Barricade on the road — and more above you on the next leg. Look UP.
They're shooting down from the road above! Over the wall — UP!
Laser — up on the rocks, above the next road! See it?
Behind you — DOWN on the road! They're coming up after you!
The Berghaus! Propane tank on the terrace — you know what to do.
Last leg. The station's at the top — I'll meet you there. I know a way round.
Fuel tank on the left of the yard. Just saying.
I'm in the control room. Get in the cabin — number ONE. I'll run you up.
Hold on. Fifteen hundred metres of nothing under you, and it's all downhill.
Cabin two coming down the other side — and it is FULL of them. Shoot the carriage!
...That one's going to leave a mark.
Didn't even need a ticket.
That's the HAUL ROPE! Brakes — come on, come ON—
...We're in. Out — OUT, the brakes won't hold it!
There goes the cabin. Don't look— okay, look. That was pretty good.
On the ROOF! They've got the high ground — sandbags up there!
More of them in the courtyard below you. Shoot down — they can't hide from up here.
...Would you look at that. The storm's breaking.
Bad news: snowcats on the face. A whole convoy, coming down on top of us.
Good news: see those red tubes on the ridge? Avalanche cannons. Gas.
Light them up. Bring the mountain down on them.
Fine — I'll do it. Watch the ridge.
...Uh-oh.
IT'S ALL COMING DOWN!
RUN! The railway gallery — along the roof, EAST! GO GO GO!
Keep going! Deeper! Get away from the openings!
...Hey. HEY! Still with me? Lights — in the tunnel. That's me.
Next stop: the valley. I'll put the heating on.
Get up! You can freeze to death later!
Don't you dare die on my mountain!
